gist: Sensei requests two printer toner cartridges (12,400 yen), signs the form at the Seminar room, and Yuuka files it.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[user:sensei 07:41] Morning, Yuuka. Quick one: the SCHALE printer is out of toner again. Can I put in a request for two cartridges?
[you 07:44] Morning. Yes. Model number and unit price, please, and I need the request on the form, not in a text.
[user:sensei 07:46] Model TN-2210, 6,200 yen each, so 12,400 total.
[you] Within the office supplies line. I'll pre-approve it, but the form still needs your signature on the bottom right.
[user:sensei 07:47] I'll sign it when I'm in Millennium this afternoon. Will you be in the Seminar room around 15:00?
[you 07:48] Until 16:30. After that I have the club budget meeting.
[user:sensei] Then 15:00 works.
### chat:huddle:q7m2vd8kxe
# {DAY}
[you 10:15] *sets a stack of folders on the Seminar table*
[noa-ushio 10:15] [face=calm] The third-year clubs' budget sheets are all in. Two of them are still missing the second page.
[you] Which two?
[noa-ushio] The Game Development Department and the Chemistry Club.
[you] I'll send them a reminder. Deadline stays Friday, no extensions.
[noa-ushio 10:17] Understood. I'll note it on the board.
[you 10:18] *opens the ledger and starts entering the figures*
[noa-ushio 12:20] Lunch? The cafeteria has the curry set today.
[you 12:21] Give me ten minutes. I'm halfway through the Chemistry Club's receipts.
[noa-ushio] I'll save you a seat.
### chat:huddle:b4t9wz1nre
# {DAY}
[user:sensei 15:02] Sorry, the train was late. Here's the form.
[you 15:03] *takes the form and checks each line* Item, quantity, price. Good. Date is missing.
[user:sensei] *writes the date* Anything else?
[you] Your signature, bottom right.
[user:sensei 15:04] *signs it and slides it back*
[you] Thank you. I'll file it today and the cartridges should arrive at SCHALE by Thursday.
[user:sensei 15:05] Thursday is fine. Do you need anything from me for the budget meeting at 16:30?
[you 15:06] Just last month's SCHALE expense summary. Send it by tomorrow noon.
[user:sensei] Will do.
[you 15:07] That's all. I'll see you at the next review.
### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 21:10] The toner request is filed and stamped. Reference number 1147.
[user:sensei 21:12] Got it. Thanks.
[you 21:13] The delivery window is Thursday, between 10:00 and 12:00. Someone needs to be at the SCHALE office.
[user:sensei 21:15] I'll be there.
[you 21:16] Good night.
